Write the lab sample preparation protocol for RNA-seq library construction. Steps must be in this order:
1. Thaw frozen tissue samples on ice and verify sample IDs against manifest
2. Homogenize 30mg tissue in 1mL TRIzol with bead-beater at 4°C
3. Phase separation: add 200µL chloroform, vortex 15s, incubate 3min, centrifuge 12000g 15min
4. Transfer aqueous phase to new tube, add 500µL isopropanol, precipitate RNA at -20°C 1hr
5. Centrifuge 12000g 10min, wash pellet with 75% ethanol, air-dry 5min
6. Resuspend in 50µL nuclease-free water, quantify with Qubit RNA HS assay
7. Assess integrity with Agilent Bioanalyzer (RIN ≥ 8 required)
8. Deplete rRNA with NEBNext rRNA Depletion Kit per manufacturer protocol
9. Fragment RNA at 94°C for 8min in fragmentation buffer
10. Synthesize first-strand cDNA with random hexamers and SuperScript IV
11. Synthesize second-strand cDNA with dUTP for strand specificity
12. Purify with AMPure XP beads 1.0x ratio, elute in 17µL
13. End repair, A-tailing, and adapter ligation with NEBNext Ultra II
14. USER enzyme digestion to remove second-strand cDNA
15. PCR enrich 12 cycles with indexed primers, purify 1.0x AMPure XP
16. Validate library size distribution and concentration on Bioanalyzer
17. Pool equimolar libraries and sequence on NovaSeq 6000 2x150bp
